full_detail.evidence: MsgType V. MarketDataRequest documented with full tag table. Supports Snapshot+Updates (263=1) and Unsubscribe (263=2).
Tag 262 MDReqID required. Used as unique subscription identifier and for unsubscribe requests.
Tag 263 SubscriptionRequestType supported with values 1=Snapshot+Updates and 2=Unsubscribe. Value 0=Snapshot only is NOT supported — subscription cancels on disconnect.
Tag 146 NoRelatedSym required. Number of pairs to subscribe. Multiple symbols supported per request.
MsgType W. MarketDataSnapshotFullRefresh documented. Supports L2 (AggregatedBook=Y) and L3 (AggregatedBook=N, Derivatives only).
Tag 268 NoMDEntries required. Number of entries following in the snapshot.
Tag 269 MDEntryType required. Values 0=Bid, 1=Offer. Trades only via Incremental Refresh (35=X).
Tag 270 MDEntryPx required. Price of market data entry.
Tag 271 MDEntrySize required. Volume at price level.
MsgType X. MarketDataIncrementalRefresh fully documented. Supports L2 and L3 (Derivatives). MDEntryID (278) present — confirms L3 order-level data.
Tag 279 MDUpdateAction required. Values 0=New, 1=Update (quantity change), 2=Delete. All three values documented and required.
Tag 278 MDEntryID required in 35=X. OrderID for Level 3. Confirms L3 order-level book data for Derivatives.
MsgType Y MarketDataRequestReject documented. Sent when MDRequest is invalid.
Tag 281 MDReqRejReason documented with reason codes.
MsgType x InstrumentListRequest documented. Recommended to send on every new connection or reconnection as instrument status may change during disconnection.
